title: Scripture and Christ
definition: Scripture and Christ belong together because the written Word bears witness to the incarnate Word, Jesus Christ.
summary: The Bible is centered on God's saving revelation in Jesus Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the fulfillment, center, and goal of Scripture's testimony.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture must not be treated as a collection of disconnected advice. Jesus taught that the Scriptures testify about Him. The Law, Prophets, and Psalms all find fulfillment in His person and work.

This does not mean forcing Jesus into texts carelessly. It means reading each passage in its context and within the Bible's redemptive storyline that culminates in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People can study the Bible and still miss Christ. This doctrine matters because biblical knowledge without Christ-centered faith becomes incomplete and spiritually dangerous.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask how each passage reveals God's character, exposes human need, advances redemption, or points toward Christ. Let Bible study lead you to worship and follow Jesus.
